stub_findings.title: SQL injection via f-string interpolation
stub_findings.explanation: The query interpolates `name` directly into the SQL string with an f-string. An attacker passing `name = "' OR '1'='1"` alters the query logic, enabling authentication bypass or data exfiltration. The cursor.execute call on line 18 then runs the tainted SQL.

stub_findings.title: Missing await on async send_email
stub_findings.explanation: send_email is a coroutine function, but it is called without await. The coroutine is created and immediately discarded, so the email is never sent, and Python emits a 'coroutine was never awaited' warning. The function returns before any notification goes out.

stub_findings.title: Off-by-one in has_more flag
stub_findings.explanation: When `end == total`, the last page has been fully consumed and there are no more items, but `end <= total` reports has_more=True. Clients will request one extra empty page. The comparison must be strict: `end < total`.

stub_findings.title: Hardcoded live Stripe secret key
stub_findings.explanation: A live Stripe secret key is committed directly in source. Anyone with repo read access can charge/refund via this key, and it will live forever in git history even if later removed. Secrets must come from the environment or a secret manager.
